decisions.reason: As a niche but relevant shop function, this plugin is inexpensive to keep open as an option while the growing e-commerce market reveals whether demand from B2B-oriented clients scales further.
ERP integration is strategically central to the firm's end-to-end shop offering, so with industry growth and ongoing hiring the option value of keeping it clearly exceeds the likely maintenance cost.
A price comparison tracking plugin fits the firm's measurable marketing positioning, and because multichannel commerce is a stated direction it is worth retaining while market uptake becomes clearer.

Even if similar to other tracking extensions, it supports the firm's broader multichannel optimization portfolio and should be kept until customer usage better distinguishes strong from weak variants.

This plugin is somewhat more exposed to later pruning because the firm holds several related tracking options, but in a growing market the cost of waiting one more year is likely still lower than abandoning too early.

Net price reporting appears more specialized and potentially less core than ERP or channel integrations, yet the firm should still keep the option alive for now because uncertainty after only one year remains high and software carrying costs are limited.
